The Banyan Tree Planted by Hồ Chí Minh stands as a revered landmark within the southern part of Thống Nhất Park in Hanoi, a testament to the enduring legacy of the beloved leader who planted it during the first Tết Trồng Cây (New Year Tree Planting) campaign in 1960.
